source_arguments.statement:
theorem radialGauge_equivariant
    (C : FiniteHolomorphicRightCocycle G n B) (g : G)
    {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ C.domain) :
    C.radialGauge (C.action g z) = C.radialGauge z * (C.value g z : B)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem radialGauge_equivariant
    (C : FiniteHolomorphicRightCocycle G n B) (g : G)
    {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ C.domain) :
    C.radialGauge (C.action g z) = C.radialGauge z * (C.value g z : B)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hgz : C.action g z ∈ C.domain := C.action_mem_domain g z hz
  have hstar : ∀ q ∈ radialDomain C.domain, ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      firstCoordinateScale s q ∈ radialDomain C.domain := by
    intro q hq s hs
    exact firstCoordinateScale_mem_radialDomain C.convex_domain
      C.zero_mem_domain hq hs
  have hqz : radialEndpoint z ∈ radialDomain C.domain := by
    change radialPoint (radialEndpoint z) ∈ C.domain
    simpa [radialEndpoint] using hz
  have hqgz : radialEndpoint (C.action g z) ∈ radialDomain C.domain := by
    change radialPoint (radialEndpoint (C.action g z)) ∈ C.domain
    simpa [radialEndpoint] using hgz
  let Az : ℝ → B := complexPathCoefficient C.radialGenerator (radialEndpoint z)
  let Ag : ℝ → B :=
    complexPathCoefficient C.radialGenerator (radialEndpoint (C.action g z))
  let Rz : ℝ → B := rightCaratheodoryEvolution Az
  let Rg : ℝ → B := rightCaratheodoryEvolution Ag
  let a : ℝ → B := fun t => C.radialValueCoe g (Fin.cons (t : ℂ) z)
  let H : ℝ → B := fun t => Rz t * a t
  let Dlocal : ℝ → B := fun t => H t - Rg t
  have hAz : Continuous Az :=
    continuous_complexPathCoefficient hstar
      C.analyticOnNhd_radialGenerator.differentiableOn hqz
  have hAg : Continuous Ag :=
    continuous_complexPathCoefficient hstar
      C.analyticOnNhd_radialGenerator.differentiableOn hqgz
  have haDeriv : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt a (C.radialDerivative g (Fin.cons (t : ℂ) z)) t := by
    intro t ht
    exact C.hasDerivAt_radialValuePath g z (C.cons_real_mem_radialDomain hz ht)
  have htransport : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Az t * a t + C.radialDerivative g (Fin.cons (t : ℂ) z) =

noncentral prime-log zeros still condense at the origin, and local uniform convergence to
normalized centered Xi remains impossible.

The surviving coupling is therefore genuinely additive or otherwise non-equivalent before
determinant formation, or meromorphically singular at the moving noncentral prime-log points.
No RH assumption or spectral-location input is used.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology Set
open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-- Universal all-one reservoir column over `ℂ`. -/
def holomorphicReservoirColumn (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 1) ℂ :=
  fun _ _ => 1

/-- Universal all-one reservoir row over `ℂ`. -/
def holomorphicReservoirRow (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin n) ℂ :=
  fun _ _ => 1

/-- Universal complex reservoir matrix `I - 𝟙𝟙ᵀ`. -/
def holomorphicReservoirBaseMatrix (n : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ :=
  1 - holomorphicReservoirColumn n * holomorphicReservoirRow n

/-- The complex universal reservoir determinant is exactly `1 - n`. -/
theorem holomorphicReservoirBaseMatrix_det (n : ℕ) :
    (holomorphicReservoirBaseMatrix n).det = (1 : ℂ) - (n : ℂ) := by
  rw [holomorphicReservoirBaseMatrix, Matrix.det_one_sub_mul_comm]
  have hmatrix :
      (1 - holomorphicReservoirRow n * holomorphicReservoirColumn n :
          Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ) =
        !![(1 - n : ℂ)] := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i
    fin_cases j
    simp [holomorphicReservoirRow, holomorphicReservoirColumn, Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [hmatrix]
  simp

/-- Literal coefficient-faithful holomorphic SC reservoir matrix.  Column `i` carries the entire
signed Bockstein of the `i`th ordinary prime. -/
def preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicReservoirMatrix
    (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℂ :=
  holomorphicReservoirBaseMatrix (m + 2) * Matrix.diagonal
    (fun i : Fin (m + 2) =>
      preDivisorHolomorphicPrimeBockstein z (nthPrimePoint i))

/-- Exact matrix realization: its determinant is the coefficient-faithful holomorphic SC packet. -/
theorem preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicReservoirMatrix_det
    (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicReservoirMatrix m z).det =
      preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicPacket m z := by
  rw [preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicReservoirMatrix, Matrix.det_mul,
    holomorphicReservoirBaseMatrix_det, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  unfold preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicPacket
  push_cast
  rfl

/-- Determinant after arbitrary finite left/right packet-dependent cross-prime matrix mixing. -/
def preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicMatrixCoupledDeterminant
    (A B : (m : ℕ) → ℂ → Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℂ)
    (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (A m z * preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicReservoirMatrix m z * B m z).det

/-- Every finite left/right matrix coupling remains a scalar determinant factorization of the
original holomorphic SC packet.  Dense cross-prime entries and singular factors are allowed. -/
theorem preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicMatrixCoupledDeterminant_eq
    (A B : (m : ℕ) → ℂ → Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℂ)
    (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicMatrixCoupledDeterminant A B m z =
      (A m z).det * (B m z).det *
        preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicPacket m z := by
  rw [preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicMatrixCoupledDeterminant,
    Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul,
    preDivisorRiggedPrimeHolomorphicReservoirMatrix_det]
  ring

/-- **Finite cross-prime matrix-equivalence no-go.**  No packet-dependent finite-valued left/right
matrix coupling of the exact holomorphic SC reservoir can have determinants converging locally
uniformly to normalized centered Xi.  This rules out every finite basis change, preconditioner,
and multiplicative cross-prime mixing, without invertibility or regularity hypotheses on the
coupling matrices.

The missing Xi landing must change the matrix pencil additively/non-equivalently before taking its
determinant, or introduce meromorphic singularities at the condensing noncentral prime-log zeros. -/
theorem not_tendstoLocallyUniformly_normalizedXiC_of_holomorphicMatrixCoupling
    (A B : (m : ℕ) → ℂ → Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℂ) :
    ¬ TendstoLocallyUniformly

/-!
# Rational invariance of the archimedean determinant profile

Determinant-one number-field congruences preserve each real and complex local determinant.  In
particular, passage to any rational rank-two cusp chart leaves the determinant profile unchanged.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

open Matrix NumberField NumberField.InfinitePlace
open scoped Classical ComplexOrder Matrix NumberField BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
variable {n : ℕ}

omit [NumberField K] in
/-- Local determinant is invariant under rational special-linear congruence. -/
theorem numberFieldArchimedeanDet_rational_smul
    (A : numberFieldArchimedeanPositiveForms K n)
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin n) K)
    (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    numberFieldArchimedeanDet (g • A) w =
      numberFieldArchimedeanDet A w := by
  classical
  rw [numberFieldArchimedeanDet, numberFieldArchimedeanDet]
  split_ifs with hw
  · let G := numberFieldRealMatrixAt ⟨w, hw⟩
      (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    have hG : G.det = 1 := by
      rw [numberFieldRealMatrixAt_det, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.det_coe, map_one]
    change (G * (A.1.1 ⟨w, hw⟩ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *
      Matrix.conjTranspose G).det = _
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose, hG]
    simp
  · let wc : {w : InfinitePlace K // w.IsComplex} :=
      ⟨w, InfinitePlace.not_isReal_iff_isComplex.mp hw⟩
    let G := numberFieldComplexMatrixAt wc
      (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    have hG : G.det = 1 := by
      rw [numberFieldComplexMatrixAt_det, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.det_coe, map_one]
    change (G * (A.1.2 wc : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) *
      Matrix.conjTranspose G).det.re = _
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose, hG]
    simp [wc]

/-- A rank-two rational cusp chart preserves every local determinant. -/
theorem numberFieldArchimedeanDet_cuspChart
    (v : Fin 2 → K) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (A : numberFieldArchimedeanPositiveForms K 2)
    (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    numberFieldArchimedeanDet (numberFieldRankTwoCuspChart v hv A) w =
      numberFieldArchimedeanDet A w := by
  rw [← numberFieldRankTwoCuspSpecialLinear_smul]
  exact numberFieldArchimedeanDet_rational_smul A
    (numberFieldRankTwoCuspSpecialLinear v hv) w

end

end GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

/-!
# Finite-prime quasi-local charge amplification

Adding an independent finite local degree of freedom sends a matrix family `M` to
`M ⊗ I_d`.  Its determinant is the `d`th power of the old determinant.  Consequently its
determinant winding is multiplied by `d`: independent tensor enlargement can amplify an existing
integer charge but cannot create one from zero.

On paper this is the finite core of the AF thermodynamic no-nucleation theorem.  Operator K-theory
commutes with inductive limits, so a norm-regular quasi-local limit of finite matrix algebras has no
parameterized K-theory charge without a finite-stage ancestor.
-/

open scoped Kronecker

noncomputable section

namespace PrimeQuasiLocalCharge

variable {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]

/-- Enlarge a finite matrix observable by an independent `d`-dimensional local identity factor. -/
def amplifyMatrix (d : ℕ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix (m × Fin d) (m × Fin d) ℂ :=
  A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)

/-- Independent tensor enlargement raises the determinant to the local dimension. -/
theorem det_amplifyMatrix (d : ℕ) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix.det (amplifyMatrix d A) = Matrix.det A ^ d := by
  simp [amplifyMatrix, Matrix.det_kronecker]

/-- A positive-dimensional independent tensor factor cannot create or remove a determinant zero. -/
theorem det_amplifyMatrix_eq_zero_iff (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (A : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    Matrix.det (amplifyMatrix d A) = 0 ↔ Matrix.det A = 0 := by
  rw [det_amplifyMatrix]
  exact pow_eq_zero_iff hd.ne'

/-- The scalar determinant loop of a finite matrix family. -/
def determinantLoop (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun t => Matrix.det (M t)

/-- The determinant loop after adjoining an independent local identity factor. -/
def amplifiedDeterminantLoop (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) : ℝ → ℂ :=
  fun t => Matrix.det (amplifyMatrix d (M t))

theorem amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_pow (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) :
    amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M = fun t => determinantLoop M t ^ d := by
  funext t
  exact det_amplifyMatrix d (M t)

/-- The determinant winding is multiplied by the dimension of the adjoined local factor. -/
theorem windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop
    (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hloop : RHTower.IsLoop (determinantLoop M) a b) :
    RHTower.windingNumber (amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M) a b =
      d * RHTower.windingNumber (determinantLoop M) a b := by
  rw [amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_pow]
  exact RHTower.windingNumber_pow hloop d

/-- **Finite-stage no-nucleation.**  Adjoining a positive-dimensional independent local system has
zero determinant winding exactly when the original system does. -/
theorem windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_zero_iff
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hloop : RHTower.IsLoop (determinantLoop M) a b) :
    RHTower.windingNumber (amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M) a b = 0 ↔
      RHTower.windingNumber (determinantLoop M) a b = 0 := by
  rw [windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M hloop]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with hdz | hw
    · have hdZ : (d : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.ne'
      exact (hdZ hdz).elim
    · exact hw
  · intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero]

/-- **Positive finite-ancestor theorem.**  A nonzero winding after independent tensor enlargement
already comes from a nonzero winding before the new local degree of freedom was adjoined. -/
theorem nonzero_winding_has_finiteAncestor
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (M : ℝ → Matrix m m ℂ) {a b : ℝ}
    (hloop : RHTower.IsLoop (determinantLoop M) a b)
    (hcharge : RHTower.windingNumber (amplifiedDeterminantLoop d M) a b ≠ 0) :
    RHTower.windingNumber (determinantLoop M) a b ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  apply hcharge
  exact (windingNumber_amplifiedDeterminantLoop_eq_zero_iff d hd M hloop).2 hzero

end PrimeQuasiLocalCharge

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Operations

/-!
# The determinant annihilates the cokernel of a square matrix

`adjugate M * M = det M • 1`, so `det M • v = M *ᵥ (adjugate M *ᵥ v)` lies in the range of `M` for
every `v`.  Hence the determinant kills the quotient by that range:

```text
det_smul_mem_range_mulVecLin      det M • v ∈ range (M.mulVecLin)
det_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_range_quotient
det_mem_annihilator_quotient      ** det M ∈ Ann (coker M) **
```

This is the inequality half of "the different of a complete intersection is the Jacobian ideal":
the cotangent module of a presentation with `N` generators and `N` relations is the cokernel of the
Jacobian, so the Jacobian determinant lies in its annihilator — and for a monogenic localisation
that annihilator is the different.  Read at a place, it gives `v(𝔇) ≤ v(Jac)`.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

open Matrix

variable {B : Type*} [CommRing B] {k : ℕ}

/-- **Cramer's rule as a membership.**  The determinant of a square matrix carries every vector
into the range of that matrix. -/
theorem det_smul_mem_range_mulVecLin (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) B) (v : Fin k → B) :
    M.det • v ∈ LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin := by
  refine ⟨M.adjugate.mulVec v, ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_adjugate]
  ext i
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.one_apply]

/-- **The determinant annihilates the cokernel.**  Every element of the quotient by the range of a
square matrix is killed by its determinant. -/
theorem det_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_range_quotient (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) B)
    (x : (Fin k → B) ⧸ LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin) : M.det • x = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (det_smul_mem_range_mulVecLin M v)

/-- The determinant lies in the annihilator of the cokernel. -/
theorem det_mem_annihilator_quotient (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) B) :
    M.det ∈ Module.annihilator B ((Fin k → B) ⧸ LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin) :=
  Module.mem_annihilator.mpr fun x => det_smul_eq_zero_of_mem_range_quotient M x

end GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry
